result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d erase the gap between knowing and feeling — make empathy as immediate and automatic as self-interest.

So much harm comes from distance: we don’t see the people behind our choices, and we rationalize what we can’t feel. If every decision carried an instinctive understanding of its human cost, wars, exploitation, and indifference would become far harder to sustain. It wouldn’t solve everything, but it would turn compassion from a virtue into a reflex.
